caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object with a rounded top edge. The composition is divided into several horizontal bands, each featuring a distinct pattern and color arrangement. The topmost band is a multi-colored braided pattern with alternating shades of green, red, beige, and brown. Below this, the next section shows zigzag patterns in red, yellow, green, and blue threads on a dark blue background. The following band is made up of dense vertical lines in earth tones such as brown, red, and yellow. Continuing downward, there is a section with a grid-like structure of small blue and yellow squares interspersed with reddish vertical elements. The next band displays larger rectangular shapes in red, yellow, and green, arranged in a repeating pattern. Below this, a band with a blue background contains orange and red cross-like motifs. The final lower section has vertical stripes in red and blue tones, curved to match the rounded lower edge. The overall object is presented on a plain off-white background.
title: Knitted Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
